## What this book describes

| | |
|---|---|
| Concept model and reference application | [`cdisc-org/analysis-concepts`](https://github.com/cdisc-org/analysis-concepts), at the commit pinned by the repository behind this book |
| Study | [TORIVA-LUNG 301](https://github.com/OpenTrialReporting/torivumab-nsclc-301) — fully synthetic, fictional sponsor and drug, educational use only |
| Protocol template | ICH M11, in its merged electronic form |
| Study definition model | USDM v4.0 |

Every screenshot names the commit it was taken at. The figures are read from the recorded runs
at build time rather than typed, so a figure here and the run that produced it cannot disagree.

## Attribution

Content based on [CDISC Analysis Concepts (GitHub)](https://github.com/cdisc-org/analysis-concepts)
used under the [CC-BY-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) license.

TORIVA-LUNG 301 is used under CC BY 4.0. It is a **fully synthetic** study: all identifiers,
patient data, drug names and results are invented, the sponsor and the drug do not exist, and
none of it is suitable for regulatory use or for any clinical conclusion.

## Status

**This book has not been reviewed line by line.** It was drafted with an AI model under the
author's direction, and the repository behind it records which claims were verified by running
something and which are argument — see its `PROVENANCE.md`.

That repository also records its own errors: several findings made during the work had a premise
or a proposed fix disproved. The lessons in these chapters come from the same source, and should
be treated as a careful account of one traverse rather than as a specification.

## The repository behind this

Everything here is generated from a repository that carries the working record — the authored
chains, the executed runs, the comparisons, and the decisions taken along the way, including the
ones that were reversed.
